This folder receives the complete, unmodified official GURPS Character Sheet (GCS) Windows
release during setup (INSTALL_WINDOWS.cmd downloads gcs-5.58.1-windows-amd64.zip from
https://github.com/richardwilkes/gcs/releases and verifies its SHA-256 before use).
For an offline build, place gcs.exe here yourself. GCS is (c) Richard A. Wilkes, MPL-2.0.
